clock_contract: Observe each native/owned call between its real process wall-clock brackets. Calendar outputs compare exactly only when both brackets are wholly within the same declared calendar unit in the explicit timezone; otherwise validate each observation against its own bracket and layout. Integer Unix outputs must lie in the observed precision-adjusted bracket. Query evaluation time is never substituted. Injected-clock unit tests are separately exact.
